sources.decision: EXCLUDED from live list; historical use only with verified archives
evidence: ABC/Disney shut down FiveThirtyEight in March 2025 as part of ~200-position cuts (NiemanLab, 2025-03-05; Newsmax, 2025-03-05).
Entire 538 staff laid off; polls-data updates canceled indefinitely.
NYT 2026-05-16: fivethirtyeight.com archive now redirects to ABC News; thousands of articles no longer accessible. data.fivethirtyeight.com partially reachable but links redirect.
Founder Nate Silver left in 2023 and took his models to Silver Bulletin.
sources.name: FiveThirtyEight (538)
sources.reason: DEFUNCT as a live publication. Polls/forecast pages no longer updated.
